scope: Object roles are separate: original initial roots are bound by ../input.json, adopted subintegrals and whole-I inputs are labelled here, comparison targets are not generation inputs. A batch may load additional moment files needed by its other members.
path_base: All paths in adopted_primitives, assembly_code and comparison_targets are relative to runtime_base.

assembly_code.role: Rebuild source geometry and actual evaluated Gamma/M generating formulas before reference comparison.

comparison_targets.role: Post-generation holdout comparison, not an integrated subprimitive.
